# Copilot Prompt Commands

These prompt files migrate the prior Cursor command workflows to GitHub Copilot prompt files.

Available prompts:
- `/new-requirement`
- `/review-requirements`
- `/review-design`
- `/execute-plan`
- `/check-implementation`
- `/writing-test`
- `/update-planning`
- `/code-review`
- `/debug`
- `/capture-knowledge`

Prompt file location:
- `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md`
